title: Hole Tools
pitch: A drill and a depth gauge that work on the plate's holes: the bit comes from the catalog, and the depth is measured through the bone under each hole.
shows: Measuring real geometry instead of typing numbers in
Tools that reuse the same drop rule as the screws
Building on earlier systems with one small change
builtWith: Built with Claude Code + MCP for Unity. Design decisions and explanation: Mohitur Rahman Zidan.

assets.name: Foot of Charcot (rocker-bottom deformity)
assets.changes: Reduced from 558,016 to about 57,000 triangles, fibula split into its own part, scaled to metres. Done in Blender with Claude Code.

disclaimer: The anatomy is a stand-in with a Charcot deformity, and the plate does not sit flush on it. Drill sizes, depths and the procedure are illustrative example data, not clinical guidance.
